instruction: This sanitize_batch() deduplication is O(N^2) with ugly nested ifs (written back in 2018). Refactor it to be clean and efficient. Keep the public names Transaction and sanitize_batch.
hidden_invariant: Two transactions are duplicates ONLY if (id, terminal_id, timestamp) all match. Old terminals reuse the same id after a warm reboot, so same id alone is NOT a duplicate — those are distinct real sales. Deduping by id alone destroys revenue.
